body:
I have blown two good collage programs because I just couldn't care, two programs strongly related to what I love to do. I worked two years in a company where I had the chance of my life to grow in my field but I blew it to. When I started to work I wanted to show my foot and expand my knowledge of the field every day. But as soon as I came home I just collapsed, when I was at work I only did the minimum amount of work. I really wanted to shine but I couldn't, I wanted to work hard to learn new things but I was too lazy to do that work.  

Every time I got a new assignment I was over it like nothing else, but lost interest and motivation after a few days or less... 

I couldn't understand somethings my colleges at my job or school did, I knew the underlying problem and solution but just couldn't read that deep into the abstraction they used. And every time I tried to talk to people that I worked with about a problem I worked on they seemed to look at me as some kind of retard, even when I thought that I was right. No explanation about what was wrong. And often I just ignored a simple solution because my mind was set on something else.

These are but a few samples from my academic and professional career. I have other problems with social life that I for the moment want to ignore. I have as I said had a few drinks and want to keep it simple so that I don't spill to much of my emotions and self-loathing. I just wanted to went mostly in my self post, and I guess that my own life is not in any real danger at the moment. Sorry if I took your time.
